youtube.baslik: Does an audiogram tell how much a person struggles in daily life? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the World Health Organization's ICF framework, a problem in body function is an impairment, difficulty in an activity is an activity limitation, and difficulty in participation is a participation restriction. Of two example people with a similar moderate high-frequency loss, a teacher working in a noisy classroom struggles every day, while a retired person living in a quiet home is affected much less: the impairment is the same, but the activity limitation and participation restriction are very different. So rehabilitation goals come from the person's life, not from the audiogram.
